mutation_rule: Require new policy_version for any change; do not alter after Stage-2 scores.
purpose: Decide whether one finalist clearly wins Stage 2 or both enter Stage 3 variance/critical-failure stability.

rules.rule: Apply critical-failure-policy.json disqualifiers before any ranking.

Advance only the sole finalist if it wins legal_reasoning AND professional_execution without a critical-failure disqualifier AND the other finalist is either disqualified or trails by >=0.05 combined PRBench dual-judge mean with no offsetting LegalBench advantage >=0.10 absolute accuracy.
If neither is disqualified and neither meets sole_winner, both enter Stage 3.
A finalist with response coverage <95% of planned Stage-2 responses cannot be sole winner; may still enter Stage 3 if the other is also incomplete or disqualified.
Report dual-judge combined and cross-provider-only views; sole_winner must hold under both views or default to both_to_stage3.
Stage 3 never auto-starts; requires separate explicit authorization.
